title: Why Tabular Foundation Models Excel on Relational Data They Have Never Seen
title_zh: 为什么表格基础模型在从未见过的关系数据上表现出色

paragraphs.en: 通过实验与理论分析揭示单表基础模型结合无参数编码器在关系数据上表现出色的原因。 Given a relational database (RDB) storing heterogeneous tabular information, how can we predict missing (or future) values in some target column of interest? As candidate targets are numerous in enterprise settings, it is preferable to avoid learning a new model from scratch each time there is a new prediction task. Frozen foundation models (FMs) based on in-context learning (ICL) and RDB-specific pre-training provide a viable solution, but the ideal design still remains largely unresolved. Perhaps unexpectedly, preliminary evidence has recently shown that existing single-table FMs (aka TFMs), when combined with suitable parameter-free relational encoders, can be quite competitive in practice despite zero exposure to RDB pre-training or relational data of any kind. In this work we first empirically confirm this phenomenon with a more diverse array of experiments. We then turn to our main contribution, namely, surfacing multiple complementary explanations for why TFMs behave so effectively. These explanations ultimately hinge on innate synergies whereby parameter-free encoders map relational effects to fixed-length embeddings that loosely mimic distributions for which TFMs were originally designed; in so doing, desirable single-table properties transfer to relational settings (e.g., convergent posterior predictive distributions). Collectively, our analysis forges new pathways for improving RDB FMs, particularly when we prioritize interpretability and inevitable integration within agentic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 通过实验与理论分析揭示单表基础模型结合无参数编码器在关系数据上表现出色的原因。给定一个存储异构表格信息的关系数据库（RDB），我们如何预测某个感兴趣的目标列中缺失（或未来）的值？ 由于企业环境中候选目标众多，最好避免每次出现新的预测任务时都从头学习一个新模型。 基于上下文学习（ICL）和关系数据库特定预训练的冻结基础模型（FM）提供了一种可行的解决方案，但理想的设计在很大程度上仍悬而未决。 或许出乎意料的是，最近的初步证据表明，现有的单表基础模型（又称 TFM）在与合适的无参数关系编码器结合时，尽管完全没有接触过关系数据库预训练或任何关系数据，在实践中仍可以相当有竞争力。 在本工作中，我们首先通过更多样化的实验从实证角度证实了这一现象。 随后我们转向本文的主要贡献，即为 TFM 为何如此有效揭示多种互补的解释。 这些解释最终依赖于一种内在的协同机制：无参数编码器将关系效应映射为固定长度的嵌入，这些嵌入松散地模仿了 TFM 最初设计所针对的分布；由此，理想的单表特性得以迁移到关系场景中（例如，收敛的后验预测分布）。 总体而言，我们的分析为改进关系数据库基础模型开辟了新的路径，尤其是当我们优先考虑可解释性以及在智能体系统中不可避免的集成时。
